_comment: Registry of the study subjects: two mature human baselines, one human first-draft maturity control, and three agentic counterparts. `path` is the source root the analysis pipeline walks (relative to the repo root). Frozen snapshots are checked out under subjects/<id>/. Set `available: false` for a subject whose snapshot is not present locally; the pipeline skips it and notes the omission. A subject with an empty `oracle` is a structural reference point only (no RQ1 correctness score) -- see the maturity control.

subjects.label: Flask 0.1 (H, first draft)
subjects._note: Maturity control (paper, Maturity Control subsection). Human-authored first release, matched to the agentic subjects on development maturity. Structural metrics only -- it predates Blueprints and other spec behaviours, so it is not oracle-evaluated. Drop the 0.1 snapshot under subjects/flask-0.1/ and flip available to true.
